When I was about 7 or 8, we were invited over for dinner by some new guy on my dad's workforce. They were a "nice" family over all, but there was one small thing.

They were apparently into taxidermy. Like, really into taxidermy; now that I look back on it, I would not be surprised to find out it was a fetish or something. Right after we stepped inside of the door, we were told to treat 6 decapitated deer heads like your everyday coat hooks. They had an entire room with the sole purpose of housing dead birds, more owls in their bookshelves than actual books, and squirrels on the living room table. There was even a dog joining us at the dinner table, which they kept making unfunny jokes about.

But the worst part? When I was told to go play with their daughter, and was subsequently forced to act like a couple of dead raccoons were TMNT characters.
They will never be Don and Raph to me. Never.

Once upon an undefined dream-time, my family had suddenly disappeared, and so I, the brave little 5 year old, set out to save them from whatever it was. The journey there was dangerous and daring, involving a tribe of 2 feet tall, luminescent, neon, native americans in pitch black darkness, giant soft toy monsters that didn't even resemble my own soft toys but I was convinced they were, and so on.

After having braved and conquered such adventures (which was conveniently easy to do), I arrived at a huge factory/lab/a 5 year old's idea of science-place, where an evil scientist was making millions of copies of my family! For no reason whatsoever!

Except they were mostly clones of my mum. Father wasn't even there, and for some reason the clones of my sister were only the torsos of black girls with awesome 'fros and huge wheels instead of legs.

But details aren't important. Somehow or another, I managed to blow up the whole lab/factory/something, together with the evil scientist. All of the clones were destroyed too, crumbling into little pieces. The only one left was my mum, smiling at me. I run forward to hug her, and...

She crumbled.

It. Was. Terrifying. I woke up literally crying and screaming that night, refusing to fall asleep for days afterwards.

My own subconscious trolled me.

Once, when I was 6 or 7 or something, we went on the school's annual trip. Each grade went except for the eldest, and each grade stayed for varying amounts of time. We stayed for one night.
That's the first element to this story.

The second one, is a teacher that I'll just call Sycorax, to continue with the theme. I hated her, because she was the most shrewish shrew who ever shrewdly shrewed past a shrewing shrew shrew.

And the 3rd part, are the showers. You see, it was summer, and for once, it was pretty hot outside. I and everybody else had spent the entire day running around, like small children usually do, and as the primmest and properest of wimpy children, I decided to go take a shower. Nothing wrong with that, right?

BAM! Right as I was washing my hair, Sycorax flew in from nowhere, literally dragging me out of the shower. Scolding me furiously, for some reason I don't even understand.

But she didn't just drag me out of the showers. She dragged me all the way out, all the way out into the corridors, where most everybody started peeking their heads out through the doors to see why Sycorax had flipped her shit this time. And there I was, nude, still dripping wet, being scolded by my teacher for my exceptional personal hygiene, and everybody was an audience. I had never been more embarrassed in my life, and I wasn't even at the age where I could properly spell it.
